objections.claim: A module-level mutable singleton cannot isolate per-request roles across overlapping requests.
objections.evidence: HOW sets currentRoles on request entry and requires every downstream helper to read that module global.
objections.predicted_consequence: If request B writes currentRoles before request A's next helper reads it, A's helper uses B's roles and may authorise A with B's permissions.
